summary: Validity of Chancellor appointment; deemed approval doctrine rejected; dissolution order procedural compliance; UGC guidelines adherence; High Court remand improper; procedural irregularities in university functioning; no statutory basis for automatic approval; Visitor's authority upheld; admission restrictions justified pending compliance.
legal_provisions_cited: UGC (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Awards of M.Phil/Ph.D degree) Regulation, 2009
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court judgment set aside; dissolution order upheld; Chancellor appointment quashed; admissions restriction maintained until compliance.
